method: Decoded temporal frame sequences at 200ms, plus adjacent frames at render boundaries. No claim of human playback or listening.
observations: The forbidden control is reached from a crouch while the other two characters react.
The ceiling support rail and the revised upside-down foot targets remain in the same world coordinates.
The cyan character reaches the emergency control before the field begins to fade.
The overload follows the second control press, and the bridge change leads into the cyan fall.
The rescue visibly connects the cyan character, the black helper and the amber helper through explicit hand targets.
Both controls stay held during the progress indication; the central character changes gestures before stabilization.
The high-five and final hand-stop use the same persistent characters and laboratory.
limits: The first button and final group interaction have tight compositions with brief overlapping figures; the three colors separate them.
Review used decoded temporal sequences and boundary samples, not human real-time playback of every frame.
No human listening review was performed. Final ElevenLabs asset provenance and technical validation are recorded separately in final-audio-integration.json.
